criteria_results.evidence: Implemented deploy_compose with exact signature (step: Step) -> StepOutcome. Verified by test_handler_satisfies_protocol which confirms callable signature and return type.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A deploy script exiting `0` yields `StepOutcome(status=passed, …)`; the
criteria_results.evidence: Handler maps exit_code == 0 to StepStatus.passed (line 179). Verified by test_successful_deploy_yields_passed_status and test_script_runs_in_specified_cwd which confirm passed status and correct working directory execution.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A deploy script exiting non-zero yields `StepOutcome(status=failed, …)`
criteria_results.evidence: Handler maps exit_code != 0 to StepStatus.failed (line 179). Verified by test_failed_deploy_yields_failed_status which confirms failed status on non-zero exit.

criteria_results.criterion_text: The returned `result` dict records the exit status and the scrubbed
criteria_results.evidence: Result dict constructed with exit_code and captured_output (lines 182-185). Verified by test_result_is_json_serializable which confirms JSON serializability and presence of required fields.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A postgres DSN in the script output does not appear in `result`, even when
criteria_results.evidence: Scrubbing is performed by _run_script_step (TASK-SSH-002) which calls scrub_process_output on all output. Handler delegates to this core function ensuring scrubbing happens regardless of exit status. Verified by test_dsn_scrubbed_even_on_failure which confirms DSN removal on failure.

criteria_results.evidence: Handler has no state or caching - each call unconditionally invokes _run_script_step. Verified by test_rerun_reinvokes_script which confirms script runs multiple times with incrementing counter output.
